title: Darth Sidious
subtitle: There Is No Mercy
text: When you deal 4 or more damage to a unit or base: You may exhaust this leader. If you do, deal 1 damage to a different unit or base.
deployBox:
Hidden (This unit can't be attacked if he was deployed this phase.)
When you deal 4 or more damage to a unit or base: You may deal 1 damage to a different unit or base.
epicAction: Epic Action: If you control 6 or more resources, deploy this leader.
rules:
Sidious' ability can deal 1 damage to any unit or base other than the one that triggered the ability by being dealt 4 damage.
If a unit has Hidden and Sentinel at the same time, it can be attacked.
If a unit with Overwhelm attacks a unit with less remaining HP than its power, it deals enough damage to that unit to defeat it, and the excess damage to its controller's base. If  at least 4 damage is dealt to both the unit and the base, Darth Sidious' unit side ability triggers twice.
